title: Caching & Batching — Group Work for Efficient Processing
key_insight: Static batches wait for a fixed group. Dynamic batching collects compatible requests for a short window, trading a little wait for higher throughput.
body:
## Group Work for Efficient Processing

A GPU handles one tiny request poorly but can process several together. Batching combines work into a fuller operation.

Static batches wait for a fixed group. Dynamic batching collects compatible requests for a short window, trading a little wait for higher throughput.

Group by model and compatible settings. Very long requests can delay short ones, so schedulers may separate length ranges.
common_mistakes: One global cache key is safe for private users.
A high cache hit rate proves answers are fresh.
mini_exercise: Draw “Group Work for Efficient Processing” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Caching avoids repeated work and batching shares hardware work, but both require correctness and freshness rules.
